single_ablation.implementation: The signal becomes available at the completed event minute close instead of waiting one additional completed minute. Event thresholds, leader-laggard classification, pre-event-basis fair-value target, event-extreme invalidation, holding time, costs, risk and all state directions remain unchanged.
single_ablation.why_this_variable: The original funnel retained relative-value events before confirmation but produced no cost-valid trade afterward. Removing the confirmation minute directly tests whether delayed confirmation consumed the observable fair-value gap.

unchanged_variables: fees, slippage, market impact and funding allowance
decision_rule: A structural path exists only if the central two-minute portfolio and at least one adjacent one- or three-minute portfolio pass every original weekly gate. Otherwise discard v91; the diagnostic cannot itself be promoted as blind evidence.
